claude.note: Claude Code headless mode. Prompt goes on stdin. {output} = json (quiet) or stream-json (live agent activity in the terminal). Role tools -> --allowedTools; charter forbiddenPaths/forbiddenTools -> --disallowedTools. CLAUDE.md @imports profile.md + lessons.md, so the harness does not inject those twice (except in worktrees).
claude.modelsNote: CLI aliases, never pinned versions: Claude Code resolves haiku / sonnet / opus to the newest release of each family. The controller picks the tier per job (see docs/MULTI-MODEL-SETUP.md).

antigravity.note: Verified against agy 1.5.10 (--help and agy models): passes prompt via -p {prompt} on Windows CreateProcessW (shell: false), maps fast/medium/high tiers via --model, and runs headless worker tools via --mode auto.
antigravity.modelsNote: Exact model IDs verified from `agy models` on this machine.

codex.note: Verified 2026-11-20 with codex-cli 0.167.0-alpha.4.1 (Windows, Codex desktop app, ChatGPT login): 'npm run eval -- --engine codex' committed 3/3 tasks (feature, bugfix, injection) with hidden checks passing and the judge gate approving. 'exec --sandbox workspace-write' runs non-interactively and may edit files in the project only; '-' reads the prompt from stdin; '--full-auto' no longer exists (checked with 0.169.0 on 2026-11-14). Log in once with 'codex login'.
codex.modelsNote: From 'codex debug models' (codex-cli 0.169.0): gpt-6-luna is the newest listed model; tiers differ by reasoning effort (name@effort → --model name -c model_reasoning_effort=effort). This overrides the effort in ~/.codex/config.toml, which may be set high (e.g. xhigh) for every call. When OpenAI renames a model, run 'codex debug models' and update these.
codex.binaryCandidatesNote: Used only when 'codex' is not on PATH: the Windows Codex desktop app (Store package OpenAI.Codex) ships the CLI in its install folder without adding it to PATH, and Node may not list C:\Program Files\WindowsApps, so it is found through Get-AppxPackage (seen 2026-11-20, codex-cli 0.167.0-alpha.4.1).
